verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents Reusable KYC. It lets applicants reuse data from previous verifications, and lets clients share verification data under agreements with other Sumsub clients to complete their own checks instead of forcing a full re-run. This covers the cross-product reuse core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of re-verification or recognition of a returning applicant across sessions within the same product, API/integration-level details of how reuse is triggered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run

citations.quote: With Reusable KYC, you can conclude an agreement with other Sumsub clients to share verification data, and enable applicant data reuse to complete your specific verification checks.
enable your applicants to seamlessly reuse data from previous verifications.
